scope: fixed first eight development visits per rate, both receivers; server diagnostic only

selection.rule: first 8 visits by (session_id, visit_index) independently at each rate

timing.aggregation: median per receiver-visit then median/sum across fixed prefix
timing.clock: thread CPU plus monotonic outer; native process CPU stage timers
timing.outer_scope: receiver contiguous packing plus complete maximum=1 unseeded dwell
timing.stage_scope: native internal timers; direct confirmation rerun was equality checked against embedded dwell result
